sections.heading: 巴西东北甘蔗园中的记录与害虫地位（2004）
sections.heading_en: Record in sugar cane in Northeast Brazil and pest status (2004)
sections.heading_es: Registro en caña de azúcar del nordeste de Brasil y estatus de plaga (2004)

paragraphs.text: 据摘要，侏儒聚白蚁（Syntermes nanus）是巴西东北甘蔗园记录的 4 种白蚁之一，也是该种首次被报道与甘蔗相关联；Miranda 等（2004）评估该种不构成潜在害虫。
paragraphs.text_en: According to the abstract, Syntermes nanus is one of the four species recorded in sugar cane plantations in Northeast Brazil and was reported for the first time in association with this crop; Miranda et al. (2004) assessed it as not a potential pest.
paragraphs.text_es: Según el resumen, Syntermes nanus es una de las cuatro especies registradas en plantaciones de caña de azúcar del nordeste de Brasil y se citó por primera vez asociada a este cultivo; Miranda et al. (2004) la evaluaron como no potencialmente plaga.

references.citation: Miranda, C. S.; Vasconcellos, A.; Bandeira, A. G. 2004. Termites in sugar cane in Northeast Brazil: ecological aspects and pest status. Neotropical Entomology.
